target_audience.primary: Families and couples in Brooklyn aged 25-54 who value authentic, quality dining experiences
target_audience.secondary: Young professionals 18-34 seeking delivery/takeout convenience with premium quality
target_audience.tertiary: Corporate clients and event planners needing catering for private events

demographics.lifestyle: Food-conscious, value authenticity and tradition, social diners

pain_points: Finding authentic NYC-style pizza vs chain restaurants
Difficulty booking for private events and large groups
Wanting to know ingredient quality and sourcing
Need for reliable delivery that maintains food quality
Desire for a family-friendly yet upscale atmosphere

key_selling_points: Family-owned since 1995 — nearly 30 years of tradition
Authentic brick oven cooking for superior flavor and texture
Secret sauce recipe passed down three generations
New York-style pizza in the heart of Brooklyn
Full-service catering for events of all sizes
competitor_features: Customer reviews and ratings prominently displayed

trends: Warm earth tones with rustic textures
Large hero images of signature dishes
Elegant typography combining serif headings with clean sans-serif body
Card-based service/menu layouts with hover effects
award_winning_examples: Margot — muted palette, seasonal menus, elegant layout
Landini Brothers — sepia tones, heritage storytelling
